title: Naming Gene Sedric 'Honeybear'
summary: Autrey tells how seeing Sedric eat pie in a camel-hair coat outside a diner made the band call him Honey Bear.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Now the one person -- the two people who seemed to be as consistent as you, through the -- not quite as consistent, but all through, are Gene Sedric and Al Casey. What -- tell me something about Gene Sedric? What sort of a person was Gene?
Aw, a lovable little guy. I'm the guy who named him Honeybear.

Well -- (Laughs) -- that's a good story. We were on our way out somewhere, New York state, and we stopped at a diner for coffee and whatnot, and when we came out, we were sitting on the bus waiting for him. He had on one of those -- (laughs) -- one of those coats, a camel-hair, remember those brown --
Brown camelhair. And he was -- he was about that tall, and about that big around.
How tall would you say that is?
Five foot, couple. (Laughs.) And he came out of the place. We were waiting for him, and he loved pie. He came out, and ppppp! (Laughs). Eating. His jaws

were all -- he was chewing and coming toward us, and I said look, he look like a little honey bear. I said just look at him. He looks like a -- so they started -- started saying, Honey Baby Bear! You know.

Baby Bear, Honey Bear, baby. And that you know, how things, you say something and it gets around, gets around. So it stuck with him. Baby Bear. Honeybear. You -- Gene say Honeybear, Baby Bear. You know? I'm the guy who named him.
